preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '12345' or c not in 'aeiou' or c in 'bcdfghjklmnpqrstvwxyz' for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every character in the output is either a vowel-replacement number (1-5), a non-vowel letter, or a non-alphabetic character.

postconditions.expression: all((input[i] == 'a' and return_value[i] == '1') or (input[i] == 'e' and return_value[i] == '2') or (input[i] == 'i' and return_value[i] == '3') or (input[i] == 'o' and return_value[i] == '4') or (input[i] == 'u' and return_value[i] == '5') or (input[i] not in 'aeiou' and return_value[i] == input[i]) for i in range(len(input)) if i < len(return_value))
postconditions.description: For each character in the input string, if it is a lowercase vowel, it is replaced by the corresponding number in the output; otherwise, it remains unchanged.
